verdict.rationale: Superset is documented as a local-first desktop app. Agents run on the user's own machine or a 'host' they connect, and the CLI manages 'the local host server'. Nothing shows Superset-managed cloud compute running agents for the user. The hosted MCP/API endpoint is an orchestration control plane, and 'remote workspaces' and 'remote access' are never shown to be vendor-operated execution infrastructure, so neither delivers this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a managed cloud offering to run agents without operating my own backend infrastructure
